message: 小さな故意の物語

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sigh... I'm so depressed...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, you too, Lolotte?」
Right after stepping out of the school gate, I bump straight into Lolotte.

name: Synn
message: 「We're past the halfway point of exams. Just one day left, so let's both hang in there」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Something as trivial as that doesn't matter at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Euu... To me, my friend is much more important than exams. We arranged to meet up right here, yet they haven't shown up...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ummm, friendship is important and all, but it's not really something you compare to exams, you know?」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady, they do not appear to be in the immediate vicinity」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu~. Do you suppose they've come to dislike me again?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Certainly not. Please leave the guarantee of friendship between yourself and your companion to me, your humble butler, Riesling Toyama」

name: Riesling
message: 「Ten minutes prior to the conclusion of exams, I escorted your friend right up to the school gate」

name: Riesling
message: 「Thereafter, they expressed a desire to take a stroll until your arrival, my lady...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that so? They must be brimming with curiosity about this world, then」

name: Riesling
message: 「Never did I imagine they possessed the skill to slip past my surveillance network」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh~~!! That one is quite capable too, aren't they?」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe they got lost? I'll help you look」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawah!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The sound of flapping wings is getting closer... Yay, it seems they've flown back♪」

name: Synn
message: 「...Your friend has the ability to fly?」

name: Sally
message: 「Prez, Lolo-chi, hey-hey. I came to hang out」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, so you were talking about Sally」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I was not. And Extra, I am utterly disillusioned with you」

name: Sally
message: 「*Hic*, right off the bat, am I getting told something awful?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, you don't have to put it like that... Sally-chan is working hard at her gyudon shop part-time job, you know?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ugh, *sniff*. Waaaaah」

name: Synn
message: 「Aah, there, there, you don't have to cry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-What is this situation? Doesn't this make me look like the bad guy?」

name: Sally
message: 「You wicked angel! You don't know the hardships of a gyudon artisan! *Sniff, sniff, sniff*, bleeeh!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sh-She's fighting back while crying...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it's just gyudon, even I can make it」

name: Sally
message: 「No waaay. All you ever do is eat, Lolo-chi!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ugh, th-then I'll prove it to you!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Squeeeeeze...」

name: Sally
message: 「*Sniff, sniff*... Lolo-chi, why are you hugging me?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Slam!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're just saying 'gyu-don' with sound effects!」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte? Why are you pushing Sally-chan down?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You didn't know, President? The Chairwoman taught me that this is how you make gyudon」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Helena-san...」

name: Sally
message: 「*Hic*, *sob, sob*, it huuurts, I bumped myself when I fell, waaaah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-san. Please focus on making the gyudon!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That takes care of prepping the ingredients. For the preparation, do this and that, thoroughly and tenaciously...」

name: Sally
message: 「Fwah!? L-Lolo-chi, why are you groping all over my body?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is all for the sake of the gyudon. Please feel the movement of my fingers crawling all over your young body」

name: Sally
message: 「Ah... afu... hya... nku!」
And after groping around for a while.

name: Sally
message: 「Ehehehe~. Roro-chi, I love you~\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is just how it goes. I bestow beef bowls of love upon all living things.」

name: Sally
message: 「I love you 1.25 times more than Boss, Roro-chi!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Being compared to someone shaped like a daifuku rice cake does not make me particularly happy.」

name: Sally
message: 「*Hic*, *sob*! I'm sorry~, please don't hate me~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I might have made my new friend hate me too... *hic*, *sniffle*, *sniffle*」

name: Synn
message: 「Now she's crying along with her...」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady, I have detected a flight trail.」
Riesling-san's ability to stay at his own pace is pretty incredible too.

name: Riesling
message: 「It appears your friend was carried off by the autumn wind and blown all the way to Kenseizaka Park.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief, Amyrina can be such a scatterbrain. Jeeves, let us go pick her up at the park.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes, the car is already prepared.」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, yay! Good for you, Roro-chi~」

name: Synn
message: 「Now she's celebrating along with her...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is all thanks to you, Omake-san. Let us go together.」

name: Sally
message: 「Really, really?! Give me a ride, give me a ride!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then--」

name: Synn
message: 「What in the world was all that about?」

name: Paqy
message: 「The angel's buddy was found safe and sound, and she made friends with Flatty. Isn't that good enough?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, I guess. I'd better study for my tests too so I can be the one laughing in the end.」
